conventions.cwd: dancecap/ (the package root); python = ../.venv-nopo4d/Scripts/python.exe. Never launch envs/mamma/python.exe directly.
conventions.paths: outputs/inputs are relative to dancecap/work/<take>/ unless they start with takes/, taxonomy/, work/ (= dancecap/work/), prototype/ or head-movement/

runs_on.local: workstation CPU (4 logical CPUs): orchestration, light checks, review images
runs_on.local_gpu: the shared 2080 Ti (11 GB, sm_75, fp16 only); take work/gpu.lock (dancecap.gpu.exclusive); only short jobs
runs_on.pod: Runpod 80 GB GPU (A100/H100) via dancecap.remote_jobs batched sessions; budget-capped; never created by the monitor without the user
runs_on.pod_secure: pod in Runpod SECURE cloud only (bundle carries MANO/FLAME-licensed files)
runs_on.human: a person decides or provides input in a UI (wizard, review sheet, narration tool)
runs_on.unity: the head-movement Unity editor/player on the workstation

units.V: video minutes in the analysis window
units.CM: camera-minutes at 30 fps equivalent = canonical frames / 1800 (a 59.94 fps camera counts twice); larissa_kadu_38: 10366 frames = 5.76 CM for V = 0.64
units.views: texture views = C x window_s / step_s

conventions.est: wall_min = fixed + per_CM*CM + per_V*V + per_cam*C + per_view*views + per_image*map_images on 'host'. For stages with 'concurrency' (per-camera tasks in one pod), wall_min is the SUMMED task time (work): ETA wall ~ max(work / concurrency, the long-pole task); front_pod runs SAM, loc and ma2d tasks of different cameras at the same time on one A100 + ~28 vCPU (larissa_kadu_38: ~265 task-minutes -> ~100 min wall for a clean run). 'billed' = pod minutes cost money (pricing.price_per_hr). risk_min = extra minutes when a known failure mode triggers (e.g. the seam-gate fallback). 'basis' names the measurement; confidence: measured (this repo's logs) | derived (scaled from a measurement) | estimate (no measurement yet). The monitor should replace the model by the live rate once a progress source reports.
conventions.status_rule: done = every path in done_when exists and is newer than every dep's done_when files; stale = exists but older than a dep (CONTRACTS freshness rules); running = a progress source is live; failed = last log ends with a non-zero rc; waiting = deps not done; blocked = a human gate open
conventions.gpu_lock: local_gpu stages are serialised by work/gpu.lock; the monitor must never start two of them at once

upload_mb_per_s.note: the pod is created BEFORE the upload, so upload time is billed GPU time

bootstrap_min.note: remote_jobs.BOOTSTRAP_MIN(_CACHED); PyPI stalls cost up to 20 min (2026-10-07)

frames_jpeg_mb_per_CM.basis: du of work/larissa_kadu_38/frames (38.4 s): 142-183 MB per 480p camera, 517 MB cam06 1080p30, 1235 MB cam02 1080p60

data_volume.source_mp4_vs_jpeg: the 9 source recordings (whole files) total 805 MB vs 2.66 GB of q95 frames for a 38 s window: stream-copied source trims are ~10x smaller than the frame store

camera_types.storage: takes/<take>.toml [cameras."<cam>"] mount = "handheld"|"tripod", zoom = true|false, source = "user"|"auto", optional pans = true|false (tripod only, auto), suggested = {mount, zoom, pans, confidence, by, at}, zoom_events = [[t0, t1, f_ratio], ...] (auto)

default_when_missing.why: the most general model = today's behaviour, so takes without metadata are unchanged

camera_types.precedence: user > auto suggestion; a data conflict never overrides the user: it opens the camera_types gate with the evidence

classes.tripod: fixed camera centre for the whole video; rotation constant (locked: one pose, keyframe localisation) or panning (pans = true); one intrinsic set; refused (safer model kept) when the data shows the camera moves (a bumped tripod is not split into segments yet)
classes.tripod_zoom: fixed centre; per-frame rotation + focal (pure-rotation self-calibration); no zoom-depth ambiguity
classes.handheld: per-frame 6-dof pose; one intrinsic set per video (tight prior, phone EIS can drift it slightly)
classes.handheld_zoom: per-frame 6-dof pose + focal (today's solver: P4Pf/P3P race, log-focal smoothing, zoom-depth guard)

suggest.probe_a: pre-calibration, after ingest: background homographies at 10 Hz on 480p grey frames (people boxes masked when detect exists); parallax test (rotation-only vs fundamental model on 1 s pairs), HF (2-12 Hz) background jitter, cumulative zoom scale
suggest.probe_b: post-calibration, from cameras/<cam>.npz in world metres: centre deviation p95 from the video median, optical-axis angle p95, angular velocity p50, focal p95/p5 and focal steps

thresholds.tripod_if: centre dev p95 < 0.02 m AND angular velocity p50 < 0.3 deg/s outside pans
thresholds.handheld_if: centre dev p95 > 0.05 m OR angular velocity p50 > 0.5 deg/s with 2-12 Hz jitter
thresholds.pans_if: tripod AND axis angle p95 > 0.3 deg
thresholds.zoom_if: focal p95/p5 > 1.05 OR any focal step > 3 % within 0.5 s
thresholds.uncertain: between the bounds -> confidence < 0.7 -> camera_types gate blocks the camera stages
thresholds.attached_cameras: probe_b cannot judge mount for cameras localised rotation-only (centre fixed BY THE MODEL, e.g. larissa_kadu 05/06): use probe_a

04.suggest: handheld (borderline centre), zoom (one step 1.45 -> 0.93 f/maxdim near 36 s)

05.suggest: probe_a only (rotation-only attach fixes the centre)

replaces.sync: pair_calib (epipolar sync + relative pose from the dancers)

loops.when: world_scale check verdict == rescale (mean or either dancer > 1.5 % off stature + shoe sole) after a full fit (scale_probe normally prevents this)
cam_refine_body gates: held-out residual improves >= 5 % AND cameras moved > 2 cm / 0.2 deg / 1 % focal on > 10 % of frames, OR any |delta sync| > 5 ms
loops.cost: one extra mamma_fit (~75 A100-min per video minute, 8 cams)

loops.when: probe_b contradicts a user camera type or an auto suggestion (e.g. a 'tripod' with 10 cm of centre motion = bumped or wrong)

stages.name: Monocular world-grounded initialisation per view (two-view)
